sheets.prompt:
Image 1 is a sticker of a young, round, chubby green T. rex standing on its two big feet, turned a little to the left. Draw this exact T. rex as a cut-out paper puppet: its separate body parts laid out on one sheet, the same drawing style, colours, texture, line and proportions as in image 1, every part at the size it has in image 1.

Draw each part on its own, spread out over the sheet with wide empty gaps between them, no part touching or overlapping another:
1. the body: the round, chubby body with its cream tummy and its darker green spots, turned as in image 1, without head, without arms, without legs and without tail: no arms, hands, legs or feet drawn on it, the tummy one smooth round shape; at the top, where the neck goes up under the head, a smooth rounded end with no outline across it; at the back, the spotted back runs on into the very start of the thick tail, a short stump that ends in a soft edge with no outline across it.
2. the head with its neck, as one piece: the big round head with its rounded snout, its two little nostrils, the darker green spots on the back of the head and the rosy cheek, turned as in image 1, with a completely blank face: no eyes, no eyebrows, no mouth and no mouth line, the snout and the cream jaw one smooth shape; keep the nostrils, the spots, the rosy cheek and the little bumps of the head's outline where the eyes sit. Below the head the cream throat and the green spotted back of the neck carry straight on down, as wide as the neck is in image 1, for about a third of the head's height, the way the head flows into the chest in image 1, and end in a smooth rounded bottom edge with no outline across it.
3. the far tiny arm: the little arm on the left of image 1, drawn whole from the top of its shoulder (normally hidden behind the chest) down to its little hand with three soft, round, blunt brown fingertips, bent as in image 1; its top a full, smooth, rounded end with no outline across it.
4. the near tiny arm: the little arm on the right of image 1, held in front of the tummy, drawn whole from its round shoulder down to its little hand with three soft, round, blunt brown fingertips, bent as in image 1; its top the full rounded shoulder with its outline, as in image 1.
5. the same near tiny arm stretched straight up as high as it can reach, the little hand open, its three soft round fingertips spread; its round shoulder at the bottom.
6. the same far tiny arm stretched straight up as high as it can reach, the little hand open, its three soft round fingertips spread; its rounded shoulder end at the bottom, with no outline across it.
7. the far leg: the leg on the left of image 1, drawn whole from the top of its thigh (normally hidden behind the round tummy) down to its big foot with three soft, round, blunt brown toenails, as in image 1; its top a full, smooth, rounded end with no outline across it.
8. the near leg: the big round leg on the right of image 1, drawn whole from the top of its big round thigh down to its big foot with three soft, round, blunt brown toenails, as in image 1, the round thigh with its whole outline as in image 1.
9. the tail: the thick spotted tail with its cream underside, curving up a little at its rounded tip as in image 1, drawn whole from its thick base (normally hidden inside the body) to the tip; its base a full, smooth, rounded end with no outline across it.

Every part is drawn whole, including what is normally hidden behind another part, and each joint end (where it tucks under the body or the head) is a full, smooth, rounded edge. Nothing sharp: no teeth, no pointed claws. No text, no labels, no numbers, no outline around the parts beyond the drawing's own line, no shadows. Fully transparent background.

Image 1 is a sticker of a young, round, chubby green T. rex; image 2 shows the same T. rex cut into puppet parts, with a blank face. Draw the T. rex's face pieces as separate stickers on one sheet: the same drawing style, colours and line as in image 1, every piece at the size it has on the T. rex in image 1, so it fits the blank face in image 2. Its head is turned to the left: its far eye (on the left of image 1, near the snout) is smaller than its near eye (on the right of image 1). In image 1 both eyes look up and to the left: each dark iris sits towards the upper left of its eye, the white on its right.

Draw each piece on its own, upright, in four tidy rows with wide empty gaps between them, nothing touching:
Row 1, the far eye (the smaller eye, on the LEFT of image 1), six times:
1. as it is in image 1: a big dark-brown round iris with a white sparkle, looking up and to the left.
2. wide open and surprised: bigger and rounder, the dark pupil in a ring of olive-green iris with a white sparkle, looking the same way.
3. closed in a happy smile: an upward-curving arc, like an upside-down U.
4. sad: open and round, a soft warm-brown iris with a white sparkle and a thin shine of a welling tear along its bottom rim, looking up and to the left; no lid slanting across it.
5. crying: squeezed shut, a thick lid line as wide as the open eye, curving down at both ends like a little frown, and one small light-blue teardrop just below its outer (left) end.
6. gently closed in sleep: a soft downward-curving line as wide as the open eye, with a few short lashes.
Row 2, the near eye (the bigger eye, on the RIGHT of image 1), the same six in the same order; open, it looks the same way as row 1, up and to the left, the iris towards the upper left of the eye; crying, its teardrop below its outer (right) end.
Row 3: 13. the far eyebrow (over the left eye of image 1) as it is in image 1, a short thin dark-brown arch. 14. the same far eyebrow worried: tilted up at its inner (right) end. 15. the near eyebrow (over the right eye of image 1) as it is in image 1, a thin dark-brown arch. 16. the same near eyebrow worried: tilted up at its inner (left) end.
Row 4, mouths, none with any teeth: 17. the mouth as it is in image 1: a long, thin, closed smiling line, gently curved, curling up into a smile at its right end. 18. the mouth wide open in a big happy laugh, rounded, the inside pink with a little pink tongue, no teeth. 19. the mouth open in a small round 'o', the inside pink. 20. the mouth in a small sad frown. 21. the mouth wide open in a big round 'O', as for a little squeaky roar or a big yawn, the inside pink with a little tongue, no teeth. 22. the mouth sobbing: a small open downturned frown with a little pink inside.

No text, no labels, no numbers, no shadows, no face or head around the pieces. Fully transparent background.

Image 1 is a sticker of a young, round, chubby green T. rex; image 2 shows the same T. rex cut into puppet parts. Draw three more cut-out puppet parts of this exact T. rex on one sheet: the same drawing style, colours, texture, line and proportions as in images 1 and 2, every part at the size it has in image 1.

Draw each part on its own, far apart on the sheet with wide empty gaps between them, nothing touching:
1. the body with its neck: the round, chubby body with its cream tummy and its darker green spots, turned as in image 1, without head, without arms, without legs and without tail. At the top, the cream throat and the green spotted back of the neck go straight up from broad, full shoulders, as wide as the throat is under the head in image 1, and end in a soft, smooth edge with NO outline (it is hidden under the head). At the back, the spotted back runs on smoothly into the very root of the thick tail and ends there in a soft edge cut straight down, with NO outline across it (the tail tucks under it): no round bump, no stump, no line where the tail would join. The drawing's dark outline runs only along the front of the chest, round the tummy and along the back.
2. the head alone, without neck: exactly the head of image 2, the same big round head, rounded snout, two little nostrils, spots and rosy cheek, turned as in image 1, with a completely blank face (no eyes, no eyebrows, no mouth, no mouth line). Keep its dark outline over the top of the head, round the snout and along the jaw under the snout to the chin, as in image 1. From the chin round to the back of the neck its bottom edge is soft, with NO outline: the cream throat and the green back of the neck simply stop there, about level with the bottom of the rosy cheek.
3. the thick spotted tail with its cream underside, exactly the tail of image 2 with the same curl at its rounded tip, drawn whole but hanging straight down, its thick root at the top: the root a soft, smooth edge cut straight across with NO outline.

No text, no labels, no numbers, no outline around the parts beyond the drawing's own line, no shadows. Fully transparent background.

animations.description: the little T. rex walks along on its two big feet, its round body rocking from side to side, then stops.
the little T. rex crouches, jumps up for joy with its tiny arms up and lands with a little squash.
the little T. rex laughs and laughs, its round tummy bouncing with giggles.
the little T. rex does a happy little dance, swaying from side to side and swinging its tail.
the little T. rex cries, head down, little tears falling, its tummy shaking with sobs.
the little T. rex gives a big yawn, closes its eyes and falls asleep standing up, then wakes up, blinks and smiles.

pause.shows: the little T. rex fast asleep standing up, eyes shut, head drooped

animations.description: the little T. rex waves hello with one tiny arm.
the little T. rex puffs up, lifts its head and lets out a tiny, squeaky roar, its little arms up, then grins, very pleased with itself.

pause.shows: the little T. rex roaring a tiny squeaky roar, head up, mouth open round, little arms up

animations.description: the little T. rex lifts one big foot and stomps it down, thump, with a little puff of dust, then giggles.
the little T. rex stretches its tiny arms up as high as they go, on tiptoe, wiggling, but just can't reach, and gives a little shrug.

pause.shows: the little T. rex on tiptoe, tiny arms stretched up high, trying to reach

animations.description: the little T. rex tries to clap its tiny arms, pat, pat, pat, and giggles.
the little T. rex wags its thick tail happily from side to side.
the little T. rex lowers its snout and sniffs, sniff, sniff, then lifts its head with a happy smile.
the little T. rex stretches its tiny arms up and its tail out long with a big yawn, then flops back down with a happy sigh.

pause.shows: the little T. rex stretching up tall with a big yawn, tiny arms up
